headline: Fight Or Vacate
caption:
Brendan Allen just told Sean Strickland to fight him or give up the belt 😤
Allen or Strickland? 👇

Fresh off a fifth-round choke of Christian Leroy Duncan at UFC Vegas 122, Allen called for the UFC middleweight champion, and said if Strickland won't fight, he should vacate so Allen and Nassourdine Imavov can fight for the title. He also took a shot at Dricus du Plessis. UFC news.

Does Allen deserve the shot?
question: Allen or Strickland?

v2.story: Allen choked out Duncan, then told the champ: fight me or vacate so I can fight Imavov.
